author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: gamma_max=0.75, lam=1.0 (per-PC adaptive residualization)
abstract: Dual BRBG with per-PC adaptive residualization (gamma_j = min(0.75, lam·R^2_j), lam=1.0) for the graph path; embedding remains ComBat+PCA64. Tests Aether’s observation with our implementation.
